name: Gosheim (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gosheim (a hand raised in oath on a white pale between red).
history: Municipal flag of Gosheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gosheim arms — hand of oath on white pale
